ITEM 1 | Rectangular slice with a golden-brown, lightly blistered crust edge, bright red sauce layer covering most of the top, and a round tomato slice with visible seeds and pale flesh sitting on the sauce; sits on the left side of the plate, about 7 cm by 5 cm footprint, roughly 1.5 cm thick, firm and dry-looking | 110

ITEM 2 | Multiple irregular strips and chunks of cooked meat with a browned, seared exterior and rosy-pink to red-brown interior, moist and slightly glossy, with fine herb flecks and small green leafy sprigs scattered over and between the pieces; cut into thick slices roughly 4 to 6 cm long and 2 to 3 cm thick, spread across the right half of the plate covering about 40 percent of the plate area | 260

ITEM 3 | Scattered green leafy herb sprigs with thin stems and small bright green leaves, lying on and between the meat pieces, a few pieces only, lightly wilted | 8

ITEM 4 | Small dark green herb flakes and speckles, finely chopped, dispersed over the meat surfaces and plate, with a light dusting of dark seasoning particles | 2
